title: Innovative Instructional Design and Assessment
sourceText:
ED4050 Innovative Instructional Design and Assessment 4 cr
This course provides background information for developing curriculum. Emphasis is given to the preparation of
lesson plans and unit plans using backwards design. Students will obtain skills in developing objectives, designing
instruction and assessment based on Common Core standards. Throughout the course, students will demonstrate
competence by creating lesson plans and a unit plan.
Prerequisites:. Admission to SOE, ED 3700, ED 3900

title: Building a Classroom Community for All Learners
sourceText:
ED5925 Building a Classroom Community for All Learners 4 cr.
This course will prepare teacher candidates to meet the needs of all students in their classrooms. Special emphasis
will be on culturally responsive pedagogy and teacher candidates will analyze varied pedagogical practices,
curriculum, and related educational materials. A field placement is required
Prerequisites: Admission to SOE, ED3700, ED3900, ED400, ED4050/ED4850 ED4200..
